name: Payments Operations Agent
headline: Clear the payment release queue faster without handing release decisions to a machine
summary: Give payments operations one conversational view of the release queue, failed scheme rules, repair plans, pre-release risk, settlement breaks, and status answers, while every release, repair, and posting stays with an authorized analyst.
capabilities: Validates payments against scheme rules and plans repairs
Prepares sanctions alerts and verification calls
Reconciles settlements and tracks nostro funding
Answers payment status inquiries and builds the daily KPI brief by rail
value: Shortens the time from exception to repair plan.
Puts screening and risk evidence in front of the analyst who decides.
Surfaces the largest settlement breaks before the cutoff.

notice.text: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.

scenarios.title: Payments Operations Lead: Release queue overview
scenarios.prompt: What's in this morning's payment release queue, and which payments need attention?

scenarios.title: Payments Analyst: Pre-release risk review
scenarios.prompt: Is the 2.75 million dollar payment PAY-3104 to Wingtip Toys safe to release?

scenarios.title: Reconciliation Analyst: Settlement reconciliation
scenarios.prompt: Reconcile yesterday's USD settlement account. Which breaks are still open?

scenarios.title: Payments Operations Lead: Payment status answer

scenarios.title: Head of Payments Operations: Daily payments KPI brief
scenarios.prompt: Give me yesterday's payments KPI brief by rail.
